picks.title: Why Matthew_s Gospel is the Most Important Book in the New Testament
picks.summary: Matthew's Gospel bridges Old and New Testaments, deliberately presenting Jesus as the promised Messiah fulfilling centuries of Jewish prophecy. This exploration reveals why this strategic placement and structure make Matthew foundational, from its genealogy rooting Jesus in Israel's history to its comprehensive teaching blocks like the Sermon on the Mount. Discover how Matthew's Jewish audience focus, fulfillment quotations, and emphasis on kingdom teaching shaped Christian understanding of Jesus's identity and mission.Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/papa-s
picks.reason: Explores Matthew's Gospel as foundational Christian scripture linking Old and New Testaments.

picks.title: Why The Sermon on the Mount is a Blueprint for Revolution
picks.summary: The Sermon on the Mount presents far more than moral guidance, offering a radical blueprint that upends conventional power, status, and worldly values. This exploration reveals how Jesus's teachings on humility, mercy, and love for enemies quietly subvert expectations of strength and success. Discover why this revolutionary sermon challenges believers to embody countercultural kingdom values, transforming how faith engages justice, relationships, and everyday life through radical, self-giving love.Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/papa-s-bible-stories--676079
picks.reason: Explores Jesus' Sermon on the Mount as a radical call to live countercultural kingdom values.

picks.showTitle: The Rosary in a Year (with Fr. Mark-Mary Ames)
picks.title: Day 268: The Joyful Mysteries
picks.summary:
Concluding the Joyful mysteries, we witness the complexity of joy in the Christian life. The Nativity brings us the joy of the Incarnation, as God becomes man, born to bring us salvation. In the Presentation and Finding in the Temple, we see the price of salvation foreshadowed, as Mary is told Simeon’s prophecy, and as Jesus is lost for three days, to be found in his father’s house. Today’s focus is the mysteries of the Nativity, the Presentation, and the Finding in the Temple. We will be praying three decades of the Rosary.

For the complete prayer plan, visit https://ascensionpress.com/riy.
picks.reason: Prayerful meditation on the Joyful Mysteries highlighting salvation's joy and cost.
